title: Appwrite Helm chart values
description: Values for the Appwrite Helm chart.

metrics.description: Metrics (MetricSpec list) that replace the CPU and memory targets, e.g. a Pods or External metric from a metrics adapter.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilisation, in percent.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilisation, in percent. Empty disables the metric.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container security context, merged key by key over `containerSecurityContext`.

cpuNum.description: CPUs Appwrite sizes its worker and connection pools for (`_APP_CPU_NUM`). Derived from the CPU limit, then the CPU request, when empty.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for this component.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget when more than one replica can run.

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods. Takes precedence over `maxUnavailable`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context, merged key by key over `podSecurityContext`.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds to sleep before shutdown so endpoints are removed first.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe counts as passed again.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

replicaCount.description: Number of API replicas. Ignored when autoscaling is enabled.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits.

enabled.description: Enable the startup probe. The first start creates database schemas and can take minutes.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the probe counts as failed.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before the first probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for in-flight requests on shutdown. Swoole drains for up to 30s.

autoCertificates.description: Have Appwrite issue Let's Encrypt certificates for function and site subdomains (`_APP_ROUTER_AUTO_CERTIFICATES`). Off by default: TLS for wildcard domains is expected to terminate at the ingress or Gateway.

certificatesEmail.description: Email Let's Encrypt certificates are registered with (`_APP_EMAIL_CERTIFICATES`). Required, even with `autoCertificates` off.

config.description: Extra `_APP_*` environment variables for every Appwrite pod, e.g. Git deployments, SMS or console sign-in (docs/integrations.md). They override the chart's defaults and computed values, including those set per container (`_APP_CPU_NUM`, `_APP_WORKERS_NUM`, `_APP_WORKER_MAX_COROUTINES`, `_APP_CONNECTIONS_DB_*`), except credentials, which come from Secrets. See https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/environment-variables.

whitelistEmails.description: Emails allowed to sign up to the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_EMAILS`).

whitelistIPs.description: IPs allowed to sign up to the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_IPS`).

whitelistRoot.description: Only the first user can sign up to the console; everyone else needs an invite (`_APP_CONSOLE_WHITELIST_ROOT`).

consoleDomain.description: Hostname of the console (`_APP_CONSOLE_DOMAIN`). Defaults to `domain`.

domain.description: Hostname of the Appwrite API and console (`_APP_DOMAIN`). Required.

a.description: IPv4 addresses custom domains may point an A record to, comma-separated (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_A`).

aaaa.description: IPv6 addresses custom domains may point an AAAA record to, comma-separated (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_AAAA`).

caa.description: CAA record value custom domains must allow (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_CAA`).

cname.description: Hostname custom domains must CNAME to (`_APP_DOMAIN_TARGET_CNAME`). Defaults to `domain`.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for every Appwrite container, as a list of EnvVar objects.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra `envFrom` sources for every Appwrite container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for every Appwrite container.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes for every Appwrite pod, e.g. a CA certificate for verifying the database's TLS certificate.

forceHttps.description: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS and generate HTTPS URLs (`_APP_OPTIONS_FORCE_HTTPS` and `_APP_OPTIONS_ROUTER_FORCE_HTTPS`). Turn it off only when TLS isn't terminated in front of Appwrite.

functionsDomain.description: Parent domain for function preview URLs (`_APP_DOMAIN_FUNCTIONS`). Defaults to `functions.<domain>`.

routerProtection.description: Reject requests for hostnames Appwrite doesn't know, and stop serving the console on custom project domains (`_APP_OPTIONS_ROUTER_PROTECTION`). Appwrite recommends it in production.

secretConfig.description: Extra sensitive `_APP_*` environment variables, stored in a Secret. Same precedence as `config`; changing them restarts Appwrite pods.

allowKeyRotation.description: Allow `opensslKey` to differ from the key already stored in the cluster. Appwrite can't re-encrypt data, so changing the key makes encrypted data unreadable.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the core secrets, under the key names in `keys`. When empty the chart generates them once and keeps them across upgrades and uninstalls.

generate.description: Generate missing credentials: core secrets, built-in datastore passwords and compute secrets. Set to false with GitOps tools that render templates without cluster access (Argo CD, `helm template`), where generated values would change on every render; rendering then fails for any credential not given explicitly or in an existing Secret. See docs/gitops.md.

geoSecret.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding `_APP_GEO_SECRET`, the token Appwrite authenticates to the geo service with.

opensslKey.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding `_APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1`, which encrypts data at rest and signs JWTs.

trackingSecret.description: Key in `existingSecret` holding `_APP_NOTIFICATIONS_TRACKING_SECRET`, which signs notification tracking tokens.

opensslKey.description: Explicit `_APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1`, e.g. when migrating from Docker. Never change it after install.

sitesDomain.description: Parent domain for site preview URLs (`_APP_DOMAIN_SITES`). Defaults to `sites.<domain>`.

emailAddress.description: Sender address for emails Appwrite sends (`_APP_SYSTEM_EMAIL_ADDRESS`). Defaults to `noreply@<domain>`.

emailName.description: Sender name for emails Appwrite sends (`_APP_SYSTEM_EMAIL_NAME`).

securityEmailAddress.description: Address shown to users for security issues (`_APP_EMAIL_SECURITY`).

workerPerCore.description: Swoole worker processes per CPU in the API (`_APP_WORKER_PER_CORE`): the API runs `_APP_CPU_NUM` times this many. Every Appwrite pod also divides its database pools by `_APP_CPU_NUM` times this value (see `database.connectionsMax`).

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The image's `clickhouse` user is UID 101.

url.description: HTTP(S) endpoint without a path, e.g. `https://abc.clickhouse.cloud:8443`.

mode.description: `builtin` deploys ClickHouse in the release; `external` uses `clickhouse.external`.

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the password. Takes precedence over `value`.

value.description: Password, set inline. Stored in the chart's Secret. Must be URL-safe (letters, digits, `-_.~`). With `builtin`, empty generates one.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every resource rendered by the chart.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every resource rendered by the chart.

cpuOvercommit.description: Divides each build's CPU limit to get its CPU request (`KUBE_CPU_OVERCOMMIT`). The limit is the build specification: by default 8 CPUs for functions and 2 for sites, lower when `_APP_COMPUTE_CPUS` (in `appwrite.config`) caps it. The default requests 1 CPU for an 8-CPU build.

createNamespace.description: Create the namespace, labelled for the `baseline` Pod Security Standard. Set to false to create it yourself.

hostUsers.description: Keep build pods in the node's user namespace (`KUBE_WORKLOAD_HOST_USERS`). Set to false to give each build pod its own, so a build running as root is an unprivileged user on the node; that needs Kubernetes 1.33, Linux 6.3 and containerd 2.0 or CRI-O 1.25 on the nodes.

memoryOvercommit.description: Divides each build's memory limit to get its memory request (`KUBE_MEMORY_OVERCOMMIT`). The limit is the build specification: by default 8 GiB for functions and 2 GiB for sites, lower when `_APP_COMPUTE_MEMORY` (in `appwrite.config`) caps it. The default requests 1 GiB for an 8 GiB build.

namespace.description: Namespace for build Jobs. Defaults to `<release namespace>-builds`. Use a different one per release when several releases share a namespace.

deniedCIDRs.description: CIDRs build pods may not reach, on top of the private, link-local, CGNAT and special-purpose ranges always blocked. Add pod, Service and node ranges that aren't private addresses (GKE privately used public ranges, IPv6 clusters).

enabled.description: Restrict build pods' traffic: no incoming connections; outgoing only to DNS, the API, the orchestrator, the S3 endpoint and public addresses. Takes effect only with a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicies.

extraEgress.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) for build pods, e.g. an S3 endpoint on a private network that isn't an IP address, or a private package registry.

retention.description: How long finished build Jobs are kept (`JOB_RETENTION`).

repository.description: Image repository of the sidecar that moves sources, outputs and caches for each build.

enabled.description: Enable Functions and Sites. Needs `storage.device: s3`, and runs the executor as a privileged pod in a namespace of its own (see docs/executor.md). Set to false on clusters that forbid privileged pods.

createNamespace.description: Create the namespace, labelled for the `privileged` Pod Security Standard. Set to false to create it yourself.

addressPool.description: Addresses of the Docker daemon's networks, split into /24s: its bridge and the runtimes' network. They shadow anything the executor and runtimes would reach in the same range, so it must not overlap the S3 endpoint, the cluster or your networks. Docker's own default, 172.17.0.0/16 onwards, often does; this one is reserved for benchmarking (RFC 2544) and routed nowhere.

repository.description: Image repository of the Docker daemon, also used to start the executor.

volume.description: Volume source for the Docker daemon's images and containers, e.g. `{ephemeral: {volumeClaimTemplate: ...}}`. Empty is an `emptyDir` of at most 20Gi; runtime images are pulled again when the pod is replaced.

existingSecret.description: Secret in the executor namespace with the keys `executor-secret`, `s3-access-key` and `s3-secret-key`. Pods can't read Secrets in other namespaces, so it's required when `compute.secrets.existingSecret` or an S3 `secretName` (`storage.s3.accessKeyId`) is set. Otherwise the chart creates it.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the executor. Variables named `OPR_EXECUTOR_*` are passed on to it, e.g. `OPR_EXECUTOR_DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME` and `OPR_EXECUTOR_DOCKER_HUB_PASSWORD` to pull runtime images as a Docker Hub user.

registry.description: Image registry. The executor image is pulled by the Docker daemon in the pod, not by the kubelet, so image pull secrets don't apply to it.

images.description: Runtime images to pull when the executor starts (`OPR_EXECUTOR_IMAGES`). Empty derives them from `functionsRuntimes` and `sitesRuntimes`, e.g. `node-22` becomes `openruntimes/node:v5-22`; with both of those empty too, nothing is pulled ahead of the first executions.

inactiveThreshold.description: Seconds a runtime may stay idle before it's removed (`OPR_EXECUTOR_INACTIVE_THRESHOLD`). The executor removes idle runtimes in its maintenance pass, which the chart runs hourly (`OPR_EXECUTOR_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL`), so a runtime can stay up to an hour longer.

namespace.description: Namespace of the executor. Defaults to `<release namespace>-executor`. Use a different one per release when several releases share a namespace.

deniedCIDRs.description: CIDRs executor pods may not reach, on top of the private, link-local, CGNAT and special-purpose ranges always blocked.

enabled.description: Restrict executor pods' traffic: incoming only from Appwrite pods of this release; outgoing (which includes every runtime) only to DNS, the S3 endpoint and public addresses. Takes effect only with a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicies.

extraEgress.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) for executor pods, e.g. an S3 endpoint on a private network that isn't an IP address, or a registry mirror.

privileged.description: Run the Docker daemon as a privileged container, which makes it root on its node. Set to false, together with `runtimeClassName`, for a runtime that runs Docker without it, such as Sysbox. For production, give the executor nodes of its own (`nodeSelector`, `tolerations`).

replicaCount.description: Executor replicas. Each has its own Docker daemon: a runtime starts on the replica an execution reaches and stays there until it's idle.

resources.description: Resources of the Docker daemon container, which runs the executor and every runtime: size it for the executions you expect.

runtimeClassName.description: RuntimeClass of executor pods, e.g. `sysbox-runc` (with `privileged: false`).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints. Empty inherits `defaults.topologySpreadConstraints`, or spreads replicas across nodes.

functionsRuntimes.description: Function runtimes to enable (`_APP_FUNCTIONS_RUNTIMES`). Empty keeps the Docker installer's list (node-16.0, node-22, php-8.0, python-3.9, ruby-3.0).

repository.description: Image repository: the orchestrator's jobs service, with the Kubernetes backend.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The image's `nonroot` user is UID 65532.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits.

executorSecretKey.description: Key holding the executor secret (`_APP_EXECUTOR_SECRET`, `OPR_EXECUTOR_SECRET` on the executor).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the executor and orchestrator secrets. When empty, the chart generates them. With an existing Secret, the executor also needs `compute.executor.existingSecret` in its namespace.

orchestratorSecretKey.description: Key holding the orchestrator API key (`_APP_JOBS_SECRET`, the file in `API_KEY_FILE` on the orchestrator).

sitesRuntimes.description: Site runtimes to enable (`_APP_SITES_RUNTIMES`). Empty keeps the Docker installer's list (static-1, node-22, flutter-3.29). Sites build with `node-22`, so keep it in the list.

metrics.description: Metrics (MetricSpec list) that replace the CPU and memory targets, e.g. a Pods or External metric from a metrics adapter.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilisation, in percent. Empty disables the metric.

adapter.description: Database engine (`_APP_DB_ADAPTER`). `builtin` is always PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL is also the recommended external engine.

extraConfig.description: Extra PostgreSQL settings passed as `-c name=value`.

repository.description: Image repository. Appwrite's image is PostgreSQL 18 with the extensions Appwrite needs.

maxConnections.description: `max_connections`. Defaults to `database.connectionsMax` + 20; the chart rejects a value below `connectionsMax`.

enabled.description: Run a postgres_exporter sidecar and expose it on port 9187 of the Service. See docs/production.md#monitoring.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the exporter.

enabled.description: Persist data in a PersistentVolumeClaim. Data is lost on restart when disabled.

storageClass.description: Storage class. Empty uses `global.storageClass`, then the cluster default; `-` requests no class.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. The image's `postgres` user is UID 999.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits.

shm.description: Shared memory for PostgreSQL (`/dev/shm`). Container runtimes give 64Mi by default, which parallel queries and large index builds outgrow. It counts against the memory limit.

sizeLimit.description: Size limit of `/dev/shm`, as in Appwrite's Docker install. Pages count towards the memory limit only once PostgreSQL writes them.

connectionsMax.description: Database connection budget Appwrite sizes its pools from (`_APP_CONNECTIONS_MAX`). Every Appwrite process gets pools of `connectionsMax / poolClients / (_APP_CPU_NUM * _APP_WORKER_PER_CORE)` connections, rounded down, but at least 1 and at least `_APP_WORKER_MAX_COROUTINES`, with separate pools for the `console` and `database_db_main` connections. Pools fill on demand, and at peak the total can exceed this value. Keep it well below the database's `max_connections`; see docs/external-databases.md#connections.

port.description: Port. Empty uses the engine's standard port.

mode.description: `builtin` deploys PostgreSQL in the release; `external` uses `database.external`.

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the password. Takes precedence over `value`.

value.description: Password, set inline. Stored in the chart's Secret. With `builtin`, empty generates one and keeps it; PostgreSQL only reads it when it first creates the database.

poolClients.description: Divisor of `connectionsMax` (`_APP_POOL_CLIENTS`), meant as the number of Appwrite pods sharing it. Set it to at least the number of Appwrite pods, counting autoscalers at `maxReplicas`; NOTES warns when it's lower.

dnsConfig.description: DNS settings for every pod (PodDNSConfig), e.g. `options: [{name: ndots, value: "2"}]`.

dnsPolicy.description: DNS policy for every pod. Empty uses the Kubernetes default (`ClusterFirst`).

hostAliases.description: Extra `/etc/hosts` entries for every pod (HostAlias objects).

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every Deployment and StatefulSet pod (not the migration Job or `helm test` pods).

podLabels.description: Labels added to every Deployment and StatefulSet pod (not the migration Job or `helm test` pods).

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Old ReplicaSets (and StatefulSet revisions) kept for `kubectl rollout undo`.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for every pod. The component's selector labels are filled in when `labelSelector` is omitted. Leave empty for a soft spread across nodes on scalable components.

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the password. Takes precedence over `value`.

value.description: Password, set inline. Stored in the chart's Secret. Empty uses `database.password`.

enabled.description: Deploy the embedding service (`_APP_EMBEDDING`). When disabled, the embeddings API returns a service-disabled error.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

enabled.description: Keep downloaded models in a PersistentVolumeClaim.

concurrency.description: ExifTool processes per pod, and so images stripped at once (`MAX_CONCURRENT_STRIPS`). Each takes about 50 MiB.

enabled.description: Deploy ExifTool. Without it, buckets with stripping on keep the metadata of their images.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds to wait on shutdown. ExifTool lets requests finish for 30s.

extraObjects.description: Extra Kubernetes objects to deploy with the release, as a list or a map of manifests (objects or YAML strings). Each one is rendered with `tpl`, so it may use `{{ .Release.Name }}` and other template values. A map lets several values files add objects without replacing each other.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names.

enabled.description: Deploy the geo service. When disabled, Appwrite skips geolocation.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables, as a list of EnvVar objects.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the main container.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets added to the pods the chart renders, as a list of Secret names (or `{name: ...}` objects). Each Secret must exist in the pod's namespace, which includes the executor's with `compute.enabled`. Build Jobs don't get them, and neither do images the executor's Docker daemon pulls.

imageRegistry.description: Registry that replaces the registry of every image the chart renders, e.g. a pull-through cache. With `compute.enabled` it doesn't reach the runtime images (`openruntimes/*`) the executor and build Jobs pull from Docker Hub; see docs/executor.md#registries.

storageClass.description: Storage class for every PersistentVolumeClaim that doesn't set its own. Empty uses the cluster default; `-` requests no class.

enabled.description: Route every hostname the Gateway listener accepts to the API, for custom domains.

parentRefs.description: Gateways (typically a dedicated catch-all listener) to attach the route to. Defaults to `httpRoute.parentRefs`.

hostnameHeaderMatch.description: Send requests that carry an `x-appwrite-hostname` header to the API instead of the console, as Appwrite's Traefik setup does. Uses a RegularExpression header match, which not every Gateway implements.

parentRefs.description: Gateways (and listeners) to attach to. Required when enabled.

timeouts.description: Timeouts (HTTPRouteTimeouts: `request`, `backendRequest`) for every rule. Synchronous function executions can take up to 60s on function and site domains, longer than some Gateways allow by default.

parentRefs.description: Gateways to attach the wildcard route to. Defaults to `httpRoute.parentRefs`.

allowUnsupportedVersion.description: Allow an `image.tag` whose major version differs from the chart's appVersion. The chart's defaults and migrations are written for one major version; other majors are untested.

digest.description: Image digest (`sha256:...`). When set it pins the image and the tag is informational.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion.

annotations.description: Annotations for every Ingress, e.g. a cert-manager issuer.

className.description: IngressClass to use. Empty uses the cluster default.

annotations.description: Annotations for the custom-domain Ingress, merged over `ingress.annotations`.

enabled.description: Route every other hostname to the API, for custom domains of projects, functions and sites. Creates an Ingress rule without a host.

extraTls.description: Extra `spec.tls` entries for the main Ingress, e.g. a certificate that covers more hosts.

pathType.description: `pathType` of every Ingress path. Some controllers (GCE) need `ImplementationSpecific` for prefix matching.

secretName.description: Secret with the certificate. Defaults to `<fullname>-tls`.

annotations.description: Annotations for the wildcard Ingress, merged over `ingress.annotations`.

enabled.description: Route `*.<functionsDomain>` and `*.<sitesDomain>` (function and site preview URLs) to the API.
Terminate TLS for the wildcard hosts. Needs a wildcard certificate, which ACME issues through DNS-01.

secretName.description: Secret with the wildcard certificate. Defaults to `<fullname>-wildcard-tls`.

enabled.description: Create a PrometheusRule with `groups`. Needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs.

labels.description: Extra labels, e.g. the selector of your Prometheus.

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) for each built-in datastore with `metrics.enabled`. Needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs.

interval.description: Scrape interval. Empty uses Prometheus' default.

labels.description: Extra labels, e.g. the selector of your Prometheus.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout. Empty uses Prometheus' default.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the migration may run before it's stopped.

allowDowngrade.description: Allow upgrading to an older Appwrite version than the one installed. Appwrite can't migrate data backwards; restore a backup instead.

mode.description: How to run it. `hook`: a Helm post-upgrade hook, when the Appwrite version changes or the previous hook failed. `job`: a regular Job named after the version and a hash of its spec, for tools that don't run Helm hooks (Argo CD). `none`: run it yourself.

annotations.description: Service annotations, e.g. for a cloud load balancer with TLS.

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: Source ranges allowed through a LoadBalancer.

type.description: Service type. Use LoadBalancer to reach MQTT from outside the cluster.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

dns.description: DNS servers (NetworkPolicyPeer) allowed on port 53 wherever egress is restricted: here, for the browser, and for the executor and build Jobs, whose policies are on by default with compute. For NodeLocal DNSCache, add `{ipBlock: {cidr: 169.254.20.10/32}}`. DNS on another port (OpenShift: 5353) needs rules in `extraRules`, `compute.executor.networkPolicy.extraEgress` and `compute.builds.networkPolicy.extraEgress`.

enabled.description: Restrict egress to DNS, pods of this release and `extraRules` (needs `networkPolicy.enabled`). Off by default: Appwrite calls webhooks, SMTP servers, OAuth providers, S3, and the DNS server it verifies custom domains, migration sources and avatar URLs against (`_APP_DNS` and `_APP_DNS_EXTERNAL`, 8.8.8.8). With compute, the orchestrator also needs the Kubernetes API. Allow what you use in `extraRules`; the executor is allowed already.

extraRules.description: Extra egress rules (NetworkPolicyEgressRule) when egress is restricted.

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies in the release namespace. The built-in datastores then accept only Appwrite pods of this release, the internal services (geo, browser, autogravity, embedding) only pods of this release, and workers and tasks no incoming traffic. Off by default: any pod in the cluster can reach the built-in PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse, which only their passwords protect. Policies only take effect with a CNI that enforces them.

from.description: Sources (NetworkPolicyPeer) allowed to reach the API, console, realtime and MQTT, typically your ingress controller or Gateway. Empty allows any source. Pods of this release can always reach the API, console and realtime.
Sources (NetworkPolicyPeer), typically Prometheus, allowed to scrape the datastores' metrics ports (`<service>.builtin.metrics.enabled`). Empty allows none.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for every pod running the Appwrite image. UID/GID 82 is `www-data`, which owns `/storage` in the image.

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the password. Takes precedence over `value`.

username.description: ACL user (`_APP_REDIS_USER`), external only. The MQTT server ignores it, so leave it empty when MQTT is enabled.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: `automountServiceAccountToken` on the ServiceAccount object. The chart's pods set it to false themselves, which takes precedence, so this only affects other pods that use the ServiceAccount. Appwrite doesn't call the Kubernetes API.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Defaults to the fullname when `create` is true, `default` otherwise.

device.description: Where Appwrite stores files (`_APP_STORAGE_DEVICE`): `s3`, by default the built-in SeaweedFS (`storage.s3.mode`), or `local`, the `/storage` volume. Functions and Sites need `s3`.

previewLimit.description: Maximum size in bytes of files Appwrite renders previews for (`_APP_STORAGE_PREVIEW_LIMIT`).

secretName.description: Existing Secret holding the access key id. Takes precedence over `value`.

value.description: Access key ID, set inline. Stored in the chart's Secret. With `mode: builtin`, generated once when empty.

bucket.description: Bucket (`_APP_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET`). The built-in store creates it.

volumeSizeLimitMB.description: Size of each SeaweedFS volume file in MB. The store fills the disk with volumes of this size, so keep it well below `persistence.size`.

endpoint.description: Endpoint (`_APP_STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT`), e.g. `https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com` or `https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`. Empty uses AWS S3. Endpoints and regions per provider: docs/storage.md#s3.

pathStyle.description: Whether requests name the bucket in the path (`_APP_STORAGE_S3_PATH_STYLE`): `enabled` when `endpoint` is the bare service, `disabled` when it already addresses the bucket (such as a custom domain pointing at it). Empty lets Appwrite infer it from the endpoint. See docs/storage.md#s3.

mode.description: `builtin` runs SeaweedFS, an S3-compatible store, in the release; `external` uses `storage.s3.external`. Only used with `device: s3`.

maxCoroutines.description: Coroutine budget used to size connection pools (`_APP_WORKER_MAX_COROUTINES`). The default is the sum of every queue's concurrency in Appwrite's own combined worker.

processes.description: Worker processes per pod (`_APP_WORKERS_NUM`). Must be 1: each process would consume the `databases` queue.

replicaCount.description: Replicas. Capped at 1, because the `databases` queue must have a single consumer; use `separate` or `grouped` to scale other queues.

groups.description: Deployments used when `mode` is `grouped`: a map of group name to `queues` (list of queue names, e.g. `stats-usage`) plus optional `replicaCount`, `processes`, `maxCoroutines`, `cpuNum`, `resources` and `autoscaling`. `maxCoroutines` defaults to the sum of the queues' concurrency and sizes connection pools; in a single-queue group it also sets that queue's concurrency. Every queue must be in exactly one group, and the group with `databases` must stay at one replica and one process.

mode.description: How queues are spread over Deployments. `combined` runs one Deployment that consumes every queue. `separate` runs one Deployment per queue (configured under `queues`). `grouped` runs one Deployment per entry in `groups`, each consuming a list of queues.
